mentions.name: Cabreza
mentions.description: Security software that helps critical infrastructure organizations create grounded security processes, policies, and procedures as a free alternative to static consultant deliverables like spreadsheets, slide decks, and PDFs. Additional tools are planned on top, such as OSINT of an organization's operational and physical footprints.
mentions.problem: Most critical infrastructure orgs don't have the budget to hire consultants, and even when they do, the deliverable is a deck, spreadsheet, or PDF rather than an actionable security regimen.
mentions.audience: Security teams at critical infrastructure organizations of any size.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Critical Infrastructure protection software that helps security teams create real grounded processes that don’t live in spreadsheets and slide decks. https://cabreza.com
mentions.author: fathermarz
